{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Verify the conversion
print('First 5 cleaned revenue values:')
print(data['revenue_clean'].head())

# Now check: are there any QA orders with 999999.99?
qa_orders_clean = data[data['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f'Number of QA orders (revenue == 999999.99): {len(qa_orders_clean)}')

# Drop QA orders and refunded orders
filtered_data = data[
    (data['converted'] == 1) &
    (data['status'] == 'completed') &
    (data['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)
]

# Check the final population
print(f'Final number of converted, completed, non-QA orders: {len(filtered_data)}')

# Check channel distribution in final sample
channel_final = filtered_data['channel'].value_counts()
print(f'Channel distribution in final sample:\n{channel_final}')"}
